topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints directly impact payload power allocation by dictating the time window for data processing. This leads to a trade-off between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization.  Limited memory directly impacts the array factor, increasing interference and reducing network capacity.  Time-tagged services, competing for limited resources, experience increased interference, impacting network throughput and latency for all services.  Advanced modulation schemes like OFDM can optimize spectral efficiency and minimize latency while managing interference, maximizing payload capacity and improving performance.
